text:
I'd go with the **Baseus PicoGo AM52 Qi2.2 Magnetic Power Bank (10,000 mAh, 45 W)**. It's a good match for an iPhone 17.

**Buy:** [Baseus PicoGo AM52 at Baseus's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). The link is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.

**Price:**
- The store price is $59.99, and the list price is $79.99.
- Code **AM52** takes $6 off, which makes it **$53.99**.
- Dealectric tested the code in Baseus's cart on 2026-10-24 and the store accepted it. Checkout has the final word on price.

**Specs:**
- **Wireless:** It charges the iPhone 17 at up to 25 W over Qi2.2. This needs iOS 26. Older iPhones (12–15) get 15 W.
- **Wired:** It outputs up to 45 W over USB-C and takes 30 W in. A full recharge takes about 1.5 hours.
- **Capacity:** 10,000 mAh (about 37 Wh). It's allowed in carry-on bags.
- **Magnetic attachment:** It snaps onto the phone, so you don't need a cable.
- **Warranty and returns:** The warranty is 18–24 months. There's a 7-day no-reason return and a 30-day defect guarantee.

**Caveats:**
- Dealectric's page doesn't give the bank's thickness or weight. I can't confirm from this page how slim it is, so check Baseus's product page for dimensions if slimness matters most to you.
- If you want to spend a little less, Dealectric lists a 15 W sibling, the PicoGo AM41, for $52.99. It's only a few dollars cheaper and charges more slowly, so the AM52 is the better value.
